sources.reasoning_summary: Galaxy Research says Bitcoin's bear market ended in June 2026 and BTC is now in an accumulation phase, supported by sustained closes above its 50-week moving average and reduced long-term holder selling.
BTC failed to sustain a push toward $85k and is trading near $80k, with longs paying funding, options traders hedging, and spot/ETF buyers stepping back as price fell.
The post notes short-term holder profit has cooled from nearly all to about 70%, suggesting a better BTC entry for buyers expecting the uptrend to continue.

A wallet linked to the Ethereum Foundation sold 2,785 ETH (~$6.42M) at $2,304 over the past hour; the author notes the last suspected EF sale was two weeks ago and ETH has dropped 9% since, implying renewed selling pressure.
Three wallets, possibly from the same whale, deposited 494,310 HYPE worth $37.83M into Coinbase over the past 24 hours, indicating whale dumping.
